structure_policy_rationale: Original 图标本身已是高度抽象的几何符号（M+框），符合主题中关于‘清晰几何符号’保留主体轮廓的规则（参考 bilibili/kuaishou 案例）。无需像游戏类 App 那样进行语义重构，只需将原本的矢量平滑线条转化为粗犷的手绘笔触，并替换配色即可。
preserve: M字母的基本笔画走向（左竖、中间V型凹陷、右竖）
外部圆角矩形的闭合或半闭合包围感
整体图形的负空间关系
must_preserve: 核心 'M' 字母的几何骨架
外部圆角矩形的外框结构
粗黑色的不规则手绘描边
无文字干扰的纯净图形主体
recompose_allowed: 将原本的橙色填充映射为主题允许的砖红/朱红或奶黄/米白
将平滑的矢量边缘转化为带有抖动感的徒手线条
适当加粗'M'的笔画以匹配涂鸦风格
忽略原图中的节目宣传文字
restyle: 材质转换为哑光平涂，模拟蜡笔或马克笔质感
去除所有立体光影、高光和渐变
边缘处理为圆润且不规则的钝角
forbid: 禁止保留原始的亮橙色品牌色
禁止使用细线条或无描边设计
禁止添加立体阴影、高光或3D渲染效果
禁止改变'M'的基本字形导致无法识别
禁止保留底部的文字标题或装饰性元素
禁止使用绿色、紫色等非主题色板颜色
generation_brief: A retro hand-drawn doodle icon of Mango TV on pure black background. Subject is a simplified 'M' letter inside a rough rounded square frame. Use solid brick-red or creamy yellow flat fill. Heavy, irregular black marker stroke outline. Shaky, naive crayon texture. No gradients, no shadows, no text.
color_application: Map original orange brand color to theme-allowed 'brick red' or 'creamy yellow'. Ensure high contrast against the black outline and background. Use only solid flat colors from the limited palette (red/blue/yellow/white).
stroke_application: Apply thick, irregular black/dark hand-drawn strokes to both the 'M' shape and the outer frame. Lines must exhibit jitter and varying thickness, simulating a rough marker pen. No clean vector lines.
composition_application: Center the simplified 'M-in-frame' symbol. Occupy 50-70% of the canvas. Remove all peripheral text or decorative elements. Maintain clear breathing space against the pure black background.
identity_application: Preserve the topological structure of the 'M' and its enclosing frame to ensure immediate recognition. Abstract the precise geometry into clumsy, rounded block shapes while keeping the core 'TV screen/M-letter' semantics intact.
fidelity_constraints: Must apply heavy, irregular hand-drawn strokes
Must use flat, high-saturation colors from the restricted palette (Red/Blue/Yellow/White)
Must remove all gradients, shadows, and realistic textures
negative_constraints: No fine vector lines or perfect symmetry
No text, watermarks, or program titles
